name: p30_acquisition_f0
title: Biohub P30 Acquisition F0
diagnostic_reason: PKT-0027 acquisition. Two passive exports on top of the P28 fold-0 control: the pre-ILP candidate graph (LEVER-0036) and the richer candidate-probability sidecars (LEVER-0037). No treatment variable is set, the consumed graph is unchanged, and no submission is produced.
purpose: ONE passive fold-0 acquisition run serving TWO levers that are then replayed independently on CPU (PKT-0027). It adds (1) the pre-ILP candidate-graph export plus its parquet roll-up, giving LEVER-0036 the honest fold-0 substrate its promotion gate requires - fold 0 is the gate because fold 1 is association-degraded (FACT-0261); and (2) the LEVER-0037 edge-candidate budget patch in EXPORT MODE ONLY, writing per-crop sidecars of every candidate above a 0.02 floor capped at 8 parents per target. FACT-0369 is why that surface does not already exist: the deployed rule softmaxes over the SOURCE axis and thresholds at 0.5, so at most one parent per target can survive - measured in-degree maximum is exactly 1 across all 2,162,040 fold-1 candidate edges - and FACT-0370 prices it at 15.6% of fold-1 GT edges never offered to any scorer. The treatment variables BIOHUB_EDGE_CANDIDATE_THRESHOLD and BIOHUB_EDGE_CANDIDATE_TOPK are deliberately UNSET so the consumed candidate list, the emitted graph and every downstream stage stay bit-identical to the P28 fold-0 control (EXP-0030) - the acquisition must not change the thing it observes, and bundling both levers' graph changes into one GPU treatment would confound them. No submission.
